title: Economic Pain and an Unpopular Trump Put G.O.P. on its Heels With Three Weeks to Go
summary: Inflation has hurt Americans at many levels: Farmers, truckers, consumers. It has also expanded the electoral map into what was safely Republican country just a few months ago.
